paquet:ordres-directs:P1.summary:
P1 is in place, all its tests pass, and tsc is clean. The new folder src/ui/command/direct/ holds the pure logic for direct orders (French comments and strings):
- words.ts: the new F wheel (1 Avec moi with 2 as a hidden alias, 3 Envoyer, 4 Bloquer une rue, 5 Interpeller, 6 Disperser, 7 Secours ici, 8 Plus…), the « Plus… » ring (1–8 unchanged, 9 Pousser un véhicule), the pill short forms with a font-width table and fitsPill, the words of each verb, distance and duration formatting, place names with their article, offender names (« le lanceur de projectile ») and the §5 detainee and van strings.
- natural.ts: naturalOrder(env, designation, who), rules a to i of §1.3. Disperser, Charger and gaz are never the ordre prêt. It also builds the « autre » line (Maj+Entrée): Disperser with sommations first, or Envoyer without blocking. holdNatural keeps a new line off screen for 0.5 s and flashes a fresh one.
- who.ts: the free rule, the automatic addressee per poste (never the company root, units given an order less than 20 s ago skipped, oldest order otherwise and the line says what it leaves), the fixed U cycle, a manual choice valid for one order with the next U going straight back to it, and resolveWho.
- caps.ts: what each unit kind accepts, the refusal sentences of §4.2–4.3, and the plain words for every sim refusal reason. The test scans src/sim/police and fails on any unmapped reason.
- travel.ts: motorizes / travelOf, one rule for when to drive.
- tickets.ts: the pure ticket reducer next(), readiness(), ticketText() and expired(), with the exact §3.1 texts.
- state.ts: unitLine() and groupSummary() (never « sans ordre » for a unit under command).
- types.ts, env.ts (read-only builder directEnvFromCore and designationAt for tests), index.ts.

Contracts: Button gets 'order_go' | 'order_who' | 'order_undo' | 'with_me', SquadOrder gets byPlayer?, RadioMessage gets silent? and reply?.

intents.ts: MOTOR_DISTANCE is gone and etaFor uses travelOf. The « Y aller » explanation now says 450 m / 150 m. With no offence near the point, the Interpeller line reads « Aller constater » / « Personne n'a rien commis ici : ils surveillent. ». Encercler is hidden from the crowd card and from the candidates with fewer than 2 units (encircleUnitCount, the BRAV-M counted once). bestUnit.travel uses the same rule and passes whether the player is aboard.

The user asked to save everything in case the Mac battery dies. I did not commit (the workflow forbids it); a patch and an archive of the new files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SafeDeal/f854eafd-7c66-528c-834c-30dfeec78944/scratchpad/ordres-directs/sauvegarde-P1/ (P1-modifs.patch, P1-nouveaux-fichiers.tgz).

paquet:ordres-directs:P2.summary:
P2 is done: a unit sitting in its vans now gets out and carries out foot orders, its radio reports are honest, and a unit that follows the player goes « en garde » when he stops. The three new robots and tsc pass. Two related tests fail and one existing test also fails without my changes; these failures come from other packages and are listed below.

1. Dismount-first (src/sim/police/maneuver.ts, tree.ts):
- Most foot orders now make seated agents get out first. Agents in their vans or on their motos leave one per vehicle every 0.35 s, all vehicles at the same time.
- Exceptions: embarquer, debarquer, a colonne not given by the player, and suivre of someone aboard or of a vehicle.
- There is no visible « débarquer » order.
- While they are getting out, seated agents keep their place in the new formation without counting as on foot (refreshFormable). They walk to that place as they step out.
- A formation that would be a halt on the spot is rebuilt so that it includes them.
- Agents walking towards a vehicle, or already seated, drop the earlier boarding.
- Who may get out:
  - Player order: from any stopped vehicle.
  - AI order: only from a vehicle that is not driving under the autopilot. Agents never jump out of a convoy van waiting at a light.

2. Honest reports (src/sim/police/mcore.ts):
- A formation is never « en place » while one of its agents is still seated. The checks allSettled and formLate both count seated agents.
- The radio says « Mise en place retardée : N agents encore à bord » when that is the reason for the delay.
- Reports such as « Tortue formée », « Barrage en place », « Bond effectué » and « Charge terminée » are spoken only when at least half of the unit took part.

3. Player-order timings:
- byPlayer is copied by copyOrder and kept when a barrage is re-tuned (retuneBarrage).
- Acknowledgement after 0.3 s.
- FORM_TIMEOUT_PLAYER is 10 s and REALIGN_TIME_PLAYER is 1.5 s.
- EXIT_INTERVAL is 0.35 s. This also speeds up the existing « débarquer » order.
- For a player order, « en place » is declared once 70 % of the agents are within 3 m of their place and the formation has stopped moving.

4. « En garde » inside « suivre » (maneuver.ts progressFollow):
- Trigger: the player has moved less than 2 m in 3 s and is not pressing to move (a player pushing against a wall is not stopped).
- The unit then forms a line about 10 m behind him, facing the nearest crowd within 120 m. If there is none, it faces where his camera looks.
- Placement: the first following unit goes behind him, the next on his left, the third on his right. In a narrow street the extra lines stack behind each other, and lines are pulled in front of walls.
- If the crowd moves round him, the line turns to face it again.
- When he moves more than 8 m away, the unit returns to the column.
- There is no radio, no order:issued event, and the order stays « suivre ».
- New tuning constants in tuning.ts; new Unit fields in brain.ts (dismount* and guard*).

5. Tests written:
- tests/unit/police.ordre-a-bord.test.ts (real Concorde map, seed 21, commandant). For ligne, tenir, tortue and couper_circulation given to a company that is 48–52 of 53 seated: first agent out after 0.5 s, all out by 3 s, the manoeuvre is done, and « Tortue formée » is said with 0 agents seated.
- Same file, AI order case: the van is under the autopilot and stopped in traffic. Nobody gets out and no « Tortue formée » or « Barrage en place » is said.
- Same file, R5 robot through the real CommandCore: « Suivez-moi en véhicules » given on foot leaves 43 of 53 seated. Then Ligne, Tenir, Bond and Tortue: 0 seated after each order, and 41–49 agents moved more than 2 m within 10 s.
- tests/unit/police.suivre-en-garde.test.ts: the player stops; after 3.5 s there is a line 11.5 m behind him facing the crowd 110 m away. The order stays « suivre », with no radio and no order:issued. He walks about 18 m on and the unit is back in column.

paquet:ordres-directs:P7.summary:
P7 is done: a player order's « REÇU » or « NÉGATIF » is now heard within 1 s, never before the order, and refusals are said. tsc is clean.

What now exists:
- **Radio queue** (`gameplay/radio/queue.ts`):
  - `RadioMessage.silent` (the player's order phrase) goes straight to the journal and the subtitle, has no voice and does not occupy the channel.
  - `RadioMessage.reply` (a unit's REÇU / NÉGATIF to a player order) plays right after any pending player message and ahead of everything else. It is never dropped (neither by waiting nor by a full queue) and skips the anti-repeat filter.
  - A reply cuts a priority 0–1 message on air, including the reply to an earlier order. The cut message is re-said once right after (the channel stays busy for that time); if it is cut again during its re-say, it is not re-said.
  - A reply never cuts an urgent (priority 2) message or the player's own message; it plays as soon as that one ends.
- **Voice** (`audio/wiring.ts`, `audio/speech.ts`): silent messages are not spoken. A reply cuts the current non-urgent speech (radio end beep) and the cut speech is re-said once. Urgent messages arriving later do not jump ahead of a pending reply, and the queue never drops a reply.
- **Simulation side** (`sim/police/radio.ts`):
  - `isAckText`, `REPLY_WINDOW = 5` and the helper `replyFlag(order, now, text)`: true when the order has `byPlayer`, was issued less than 5 s ago, and the text is an REÇU/NÉGATIF.
  - `kernel.say` uses `replyFlag` and sends such messages on `commandement` with `reply: true`. That covers every unit acknowledgement and every simulation refusal.
  - The same rule is in `sim/police/command/core.ts say()`, so BRAV-M, engines and drone use it too. This was P3's hook; I did it.
- **Reports** go to the player:
  - `superior()` returns `playerCallsign()` for a `byPlayer` order: the unit he commands, or « AUTORITÉ » (commandant/commissaire) / « CHEF MISTRAL 1 » when he ordered his own unit. Before, an order to the commandant's own company was reported to CENTRAL.
- **Wording**:
  - The ack distance is now the order's distance: measured from the unit leader, with the same rounding as the order phrase (« QUATRE-ZÉRO », not « QUATRE-CINQ »).
  - « proteger » now says « je protège le canon à eau / le Centaure ».
  - « Avancer » now reports « Sur le point, <rue>, en ligne face …, N à pied » (or « en colonne par deux ») instead of « Barrage en place ».
  - The detainee radio phrases now say « conduit au fourgon cellulaire » and « à bord du fourgon cellulaire, en attente de transfert ». « point de regroupement » and « officier de police judiciaire » are gone from them. PHRASES.md was regenerated.
- **Player orders are now marked and silent in the game** (`ui/command/core.ts`, P8's file):
  - `byPlayer: true` is set on every order sent by `CommandCore.issue`, on the on-foot `suivre` fallback in `callWithMe`, and on the order replayed after a convoy (`onConvoyStage`).
  - The player's order phrases are sent with `silent: true`.
  - The store-squads copy of `byPlayer` was already added by the parallel P2 agent.

Robot result (Concorde seed 21, commandant, CENTRAL chatter on both nets): Tenir 0.37 s, Avancer 40 m 0.37 s (ack says « QUATRE-ZÉRO »), Bloquer by the map card 0.33 s, BRAV-M Interpeller 0.03 s (17 s before), refusal « NÉGATIF. Aucun individu à interpeller sur fait constaté » 0.03 s. Each ack comes after the order phrase, which is silent.

Same setup (Concorde seed 21, card pipeline). It also asserts the refusal is said, the ack's 40 m distance, and that reports go to the player. commandant-terrain is unchanged and green.

Several edits are in files owned by other packages, each kept small:
- ui/command/core.ts (P8): byPlayer: true on CommandCore.issue, the on-foot callWithMe fallback and onConvoyStage; silent: true on the player's order phrases. Without them nothing sets byPlayer or silent in stage 1b, so the reply lane, P2's player timings and P3's handleOrder rule would do nothing in the real game. The accepted adjoint proposal was not checked: byPlayer only reaches it if it goes through CommandCore.issue.
- sim/police/command/core.ts (P3): the say() reply hook, which §2.4 assigned to P3. Without it the BRAV-M ack stayed late.
- sim/police/maneuver.ts (P2, re-read just before editing): only the two « Avancer » report lines and one import.
- audio/speech.ts and audio/wiring.ts (owned by no package): needed so silent is really not spoken and a reply is really heard first.

A reply may cut the reply to an earlier order. The spec says « pre-empts priority 0–1 » and a reply is priority 1. Without this, two orders a few seconds apart left the second ack waiting 6–8 s behind the first (the queue estimates about 13 characters per second). The cut ack is re-said once.
The 9-word cap on spoken replies is not enforced by trimming text: trimming would drop the place name. Ack bodies are short clauses already; the ≤ 1 s goal is met by pre-emption instead.

Re-queuing a cut message is modelled two ways. The radio queue keeps the channel busy for the re-say, but the cut message is not logged or subtitled again. The voice (speech.ts) re-says it once. This avoids a duplicate journal line.

CENTRAL repeat cap: no new code. The reviewed « colonne-tete-bloquee » lot already in the tree (incidents/radio.ts KIND_QUIET, test incidents.radio-sans-rafale, green) silences repeats of the same incident type nearby; each incident is announced at most once on opening and once if it worsens. Quieted messages are dropped rather than written « journal only ».

ackBody finds the ordering unit by matching the order object in k.units, so the ack distance comes from the unit leader without changing the callers' signatures (maneuver.ts and system.ts still pass their own distance as a fallback).

Existing test changed on purpose: ui-command.meme-lieu waited for the player's order phrase to come out of the radio queue, and that wait (seconds of wall time) let the map snapshot refresh. The phrase is now written instantly, so the test calls core.maps.scene.invalidate() before reading the units. The assertions are unchanged.
openIssues: P6 (follow.ts): orders issued by follow.ts (« Avec moi » on foot / in vehicles: suivre, embarquer, debarquer) do not carry byPlayer yet. Their acks therefore use the normal lane, not the ≤ 1 s reply lane. P6 should set byPlayer: true on the orders that come from the player's « Avec moi ».

P8: the callsign fix of §2.4 is not done. When the commandant speaks to his own company, his phrase still reads « MISTRAL ICI MISTRAL ». Reports sent back to him already use « AUTORITÉ ICI MISTRAL ». P8 should make CommandCore.callsign() / `from` match sim/police/radio.ts playerCallsign().
P3: the reply hook is already in sim/police/command/core.ts say(): it finds the speaking squad by name and calls replyFlag. P3 should keep it when it takes over that file.

P12/P13: the real radio lines at hand-over still come from law/custody.ts (« … à bord du véhicule pour présentation à l'officier de police judiciaire ») and from ops-arrest.ts / bravm.ts (« point de regroupement »). paquet:ordres-directs:P5.summary:
P5 is in place, apart from one known red test and one decision (BRAV-M on a service day) that P6 must finish; complete=false for that reason. tsc is clean.

What now exists:
- **Everyone follows the player from the start.** `setup.ts everyoneFollows()` gives `suivre` to the highest unit the player leads. The `members.length > 1` test and the commandant/commissaire exclusion are gone. The commandant's whole company follows him (sections, BRAV-M, water cannon, drone, cellular vans). A chef de section's section and its 3 groups follow him; the chef de groupe and an engine chief get their unit. Not given to the patrol crew, the BRAV-M passenger, or the commandant in « salle de commandement ».
- **The AI no longer orders the chef de section's groups.** I added one guard in `command.ts sections()` so it skips a section led by the player. Without it the AI put ALFA/BRAVO in `ligne` at t < 3 s. P3 has since widened it to `underPlayer()`.
- **BRAV-M inside the company.** `BravmOptions.parentId` is new and `createBravm` uses it; `setup.ts` passes the company id. This holds in free mode / « déjà sur place » and in missions without a service day. On a service day the BRAV-M stays a top unit (see deviations).
- **Crewed cellular vans.**
  - `CompanyOptions.cellular` is new (default true); setup and `manifestations.ts` pass `false`, so the company no longer makes a van with no crew.
  - Vans are built with `createEquipage('fourgon_cellulaire', { parentId: company })`: CELLULAIRE 1…4, conductor at the wheel, chef de bord beside him, 8 free cells.
  - Count: max(2, ⌈declared crowd/400⌉), capped at 4, with a company (`cellularCount`); an explicit `extra.moyens.cellulaires` is read through `RequestedMeans.cellulaires`.
  - Forces with no company (BRAV-M, engine, drone, school group): 1 van (`loneCellular`). Patrol duty shift: none. Each extra demonstration company gets 1.
  - The census over all 116 missions: every mission with police has ≥ 1 van; every company has 2–4; no company → exactly 1.
- **Point de remise (new `src/gameplay/session/remise.ts`).**
  - Vans are parked 60–100 m behind the line, away from the crowd, along the kerb of a road that stays passable (≥ 13 m wide preferred, ≥ 7.5 m minimum), at least 30 m from the units' parked vehicles. Fallbacks: 40–140 m, then the nearest free road.
  - Service `session.remise`: `point()`, `vans()`, `track()`.
  - A `RemiseTracker` (updated by `SessionSetupSystem.update`) re-sets the point when the line has moved > 80 m and stopped for 10 s. Available vans drive there by autopilot, no siren, using park/driveTo. A van is not available if it has a player order, its own convoy, is in the player's column, has the player aboard, or is already driving.
  - It also waits while company vehicles manoeuvre within 150 m. A van still manoeuvring after 120 s is stopped where it is.
  - On a service day the vans leave with the column (crew aboard) and the point is set once the column has unloaded.
- **Small hooks elsewhere:**
  - `follow.ts`: a cellular van joins the player's vehicle column only on an explicit « en colonne » order, otherwise it stays at the remise.
  - `units.ts`: BRAV-M motos are never parked on a lawn on the first try.
  - `scenario.ts` preview: line « Fourgons cellulaires — N fourgons, pour les interpellés ».
  - `EngagedMeans.cellulaires` is counted.
  - The crew's appearance seed comes from the session seed, so the vans do not draw from the police random generator.
- **Tests (new):**
  - `tests/unit/session.tous-me-suivent.test.ts` (4 postes, BRAV-M parent = company, in scope).
  - `tests/unit/session.cellulaires.test.ts`: 150/600/3000 → 2/2/4, 55–105 m from the line, behind it; the remise follows a line moved 150 m; service day: vans leave with the column, point set ≤ 150 m from the line; census of every mission.

- integration.suivre, integration.forces, integration.moyens, integration.manifestations-multiples, integration.avec-moi, integration.suivre-colonne, ui.libre: 7 files, 47/47 pass.
- playtest.modes, playtest.modes-accueil, playtest.missions-accueil, playtest.missions-police, playtest.missions-engins, playtest.missions-soins, playtest.apparition-roles (whole matrix): 7 files, 49/49 pass.
- integration.journee, integration.journee.bravm, playtest.commandant-terrain, playtest.commandant-compagnie, playtest.missions-police, playtest.modes, playtest.bravm-passager: 22 passed, 1 failed (playtest.bravm-passager « mode libre : Place de la Bastille (graine 22) »; see openIssues).
- Earlier in the same session, before the last remise tuning: bravm.*, integration.colonnes-bravm, session.bravm-concorde, playtest.commandant-interpeller / -autre-unite / -patrouille / -nasse-ouverte, police-command.unites-speciales: all pass.
- Last run of session.cellulaires « journée » after the last remise.ts edit: pass (point de remise 87 m from the line).
- playtest.commandant-mission-colonne: green in its first run here (its only failure then was the BRAV-M filter, now restored). Red in the two later runs, while another agent was editing convoy.ts, core.ts, adjoint.ts and bravm.ts (see openIssues). playtest.commandant-mission-01…15 are skipped by default in their files.
deviations: Service day: the BRAV-M is NOT attached to the company (`parentId` only outside the service day). The company's column orders (embarquer, débarquer) go to its whole tree, and the BRAV-M started 2 km away at its own station: integration.journee.bravm and 3 cases of playtest.bravm-passager went red. I then tried attaching it on arrival. That made a company-wide « Tenir une ligne » pull the BRAV-M into the line and broke playtest.commandant-mission-colonne (it expects FAUCON groups with parentId 0), so I removed it.

The van count is decided at session start from the declared crowd (`cellularCount` in remise.ts), not in the home screen's `recommendedMeans`/`ScenarioMeans`. There is no new stepper and no new key in the default config: ui.libre freezes the default config (« aucune clé nouvelle ») and a stored count would go stale when the crowd size changes. `RequestedMeans.cellulaires` still reads an explicit `extra.moyens.cellulaires`. Mission catalogue means were not edited: setup gives every mission with police at least 1 van.
`placement.ts` was not changed: the remise search is in the new remise.ts (`remiseSpot`, `remiseNearest`, `parkBehind`, `vanFits`).

Small edits in files of other packages, each local. `command.ts` (P3): skip the section led by the player, needed for « chef de section : every squad in scope `suivre` at t = 3 s »; P3 has already widened it. `follow.ts` (P6): a cellular van joins the player's column only on an explicit « en colonne » order. `session/api.ts`: type changes only. `roster.ts` (P4): `RequestedMeans.cellulaires`.

Tests updated because the behaviour changed on purpose. `session.depart-base` « commissariat du 1er »: the recorded 7-vehicle layout now excludes the 2 crewed vans; they are parked behind the file and must also leave. `integration.forces`: cellular vans must be behind the unit but are no longer required to be in the block's axis (they are at the remise, along their road).
Chef de la BRAV-M: the poste `chef_bravm` does not exist yet (P4). The « tous me suivent » test uses role `bravm` with poste `pilote_moto`, where the player already leads his BRAV-M group.
Remise distance: each van is 60–100 m from the stand; measured from the moving centre of the company's agents on foot it is 57–95 m, and the test allows 55–105 m.
openIssues: P6 / P3: on a service day, attach the BRAV-M to the company (or create it with `parentId`). This needs company column orders to stop being copied onto the BRAV-M (P3: per-squad `debarquer`, handleOrder rule) and a company-wide « ligne » not to pull it into the line (plan §4.2: the BRAV-M does not hold a barrage). Until then the service-day BRAV-M is outside « Toute la compagnie ».

playtest.bravm-passager « mode libre : Place de la Bastille (graine 22) » is red: one moto ends 469 m away. It is green when the lone van is not created.
